name: pw-benefits
label: Benefits section (quote, columns, list)
description: Section with label, rule, headline, an optional pull quote, a row of hairline-topped columns, a labelled list with rules and an italic-free closing note.

defaults.closing: These patterns took decades to form. The book gives you a clear map and practices to return to, one conversation at a time.

columns.body: Your partner reaches for you. Your children bring you what is hard as well as what is impressive. Conflict ends in repair, and the distance between you begins to close.
columns.label: AT HOME

columns.body: People tell you what is actually happening. They commit to decisions they helped shape. Your best people stay, and the way your team works holds when you are out of the room.
columns.label: AT WORK

columns.body: The exhaustion of holding it all together begins to lift. You can be wrong and stay steady. You can be affected and remain intact.
columns.label: WITHIN YOU

defaults.headline: Power and closeness, held together.

items.text: Recognize the defended patterns running beneath your success, and the moment they take over.
Stay present in the conversations you used to win, avoid or end.
Acknowledge impact before you explain intent.
Repair after rupture, so trust grows stronger through conflict.
Lead from relational authority, the kind people follow by choice.
Use the pause, the thirty seconds that change what you say next.

defaults.listLabel: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN TO DO
defaults.quote: My intent in writing this book is to support you in becoming more powerful than you have ever been, while building the quality of relationships your life actually depends on.
